summary: A single Secure Agility camera (324) covers six zones at Oxford St and York Rd, Bondi Junction; the busy Oxford St cycleway zones (512, 516) are clean and consistent, with seasonal and rain-driven variation. The low-volume road zones (518/1468 above all, plus 517, 519 and 520) have zero slots and zero days left out by the feed, which zero_fill restores. There were three camera-wide stretches of false zeros: the start of the record on 2024-11-18, an outage from 27 Sep to 2 Oct 2025, and the afternoon of the last day (2026-09-26), which looks cut off; all three are set missing, and no series definition is needed.
